description: Fork of exp016 (n_heads=6) with per-head partition_sets on out_proj. Each anchor pair in out_proj's bit-LUT is restricted to dims of the SAME attention head (within-head comparisons only); a single table can still mix heads across its 8 anchor pairs. Valid pair pool drops C(96,2)=4560 -> H*C(16,2)=720 (16% of unrestricted). Tests whether biasing out_proj toward per-head feature comparisons (vs cross-head mixing) helps representation learning.
